rows.label: Trailing P/E stretched
rows.rule: Trailing 12m P/E more than 1σ above its own 20-year mean
rows.note: Earnings are as-reported (GAAP), so this prints above an operating-earnings P/E; the band uses the same basis. Shiller leaves earnings blank until a quarter is reported, so the latest two or three months are normally a dash.

rows.label: CAPE stretched
rows.rule: CAPE more than 1σ above its own 20-year mean
rows.note: A rolling band, not a fixed level: a fixed CAPE threshold has been triggered almost continuously since 1992 and says nothing.

rows.label: Volatility complacency
rows.rule: 6-month average VIX in the bottom quartile of its trailing 10 years
rows.note: The free stand-in for positioning and survey rows on a sell-side checklist. It measures what options cost, not what anyone says.

rows.label: Credit complacency
rows.rule: 3-month average Baa−10y spread in the bottom quartile of its trailing 10 years
rows.note: Moody's Baa over the 10-year Treasury rather than an ICE BofA HY OAS: FRED serves only a rolling three years of the ICE series. This one is daily from 1986.

rows.label: Curve inverted within 12 months
rows.rule: 10y minus 3m below zero at any point in the trailing 12 months
rows.note: Evaluated daily before being collapsed to months, so a brief inversion between two month-ends still counts.

rows.label: Policy tightened
rows.rule: Fed funds 100bp or more above its trailing 36-month low
rows.note: Measured from the trough rather than as a fixed-lookback change: a 24-month difference nets a hiking year against a cutting year and fires at neither the 2000 nor the 2007 peak.

rows.label: Banks tightening standards
rows.rule: SLOOS net % tightening C&I standards above zero (more tightening than easing)
rows.note: Quarterly. Carried forward up to three months so the flag persists between surveys.

rows.label: Labour market at cycle tights
rows.rule: Unemployment within 0.3pp of its trailing 36-month low

rows.label: Quality decompression widening
rows.rule: CCC minus BB spread 100bp or more above its trailing 12-month low
rows.note: Turns late rather than early (a confirmation, not a warning). FRED serves only a rolling ~3 years of the ICE BofA series, so this row cannot reach the peak columns.
